verdict.line: You lose this if you eat Ornn's Q slow at range and let him kite the fight; you win it if you close distance behind your own Q and force melee trades.

brief.thesis: Garen's only real disadvantage is range — Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture, 800 range) and W (Bellows Breath) let him poke from outside your kit — but once you're in melee his longer cooldowns (9-7s on Q, 14-12s on E) mean he has nothing to answer a full E-W-Q rotation with. That gap is why Garen holds both the lane advantage and the solo-kill edge here (51.9% win rate over 1,619 games) even though the matchup evens out by midgame as his Living Forge stats and masterwork items catch up.

theirWindow.when: he lands Q slow from range
theirWindow.what: He'll follow the slow with W's fire or another poke while you're stuck closing distance — use your own Q's move speed burst immediately to break the slow instead of walking it off.

yourWindow.when: his E and Q are both down
yourWindow.what: With no dash to disengage and no slow to re-apply, he's stuck in melee range; dive with E (Judgment) spin and Q's silenced bonus-damage auto to stack Conqueror and force the trade.

powerCurve.note: Trading range only, neither has kill pressure
Q breaks his slow, closes the gap fast
R execute threat forces him passive
His E-into-knockup chain starts flipping trades
Living Forge bonus stats offset your damage

start.why: The higher-winrate start (52.4% over 939 games) — the flat damage reduction on taking poke keeps you healthy through his Q chip while you close distance level by level.

boots.why: 74% pick rate and the best winrate of the two boot options; the attack speed feeds Conqueror stacks faster once you're in his face.

core.why: The slow-on-hit and burst from the active is what actually lets you stick to him through his Q slow instead of getting kited back out to his range.
Attack speed keeps Conqueror stacking and lets you out-trade his Living Forge resistances in extended fights.
Grievous Wounds cuts into whatever healing he picks up from items, closing out fights he'd otherwise stabilize out of.

situational.when: you're ahead and need to stick onto him through extended skirmishes rather than burst him down
his stacking resistances from Living Forge are making your autos feel soft
you need the extra mobility to catch him before he reaches his E's terrain knockup setup

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards exactly the playstyle this matchup demands — staying in extended melee trades rather than poke exchanges — and stacks hardest during your E spin and sustained auto-attacking once you've closed distance.

summoners.why: The dominant pick at 92.3% — Ignite converts your measured solo-kill advantage into actual kills once your Q silence and E spin land, denying any sustain he's built.

playing.title: Close distance behind Q
playing.detail: Use Q (Decisive Strike, 8s cooldown) the moment he lands a slow on you — it breaks the slow and gives you the move speed burst needed to close his range advantage before he resets to max distance.

playing.title: Track his E before standing near walls
playing.detail: Ornn's E (Searing Charge, 14-12s cooldown) only knocks up if he collides with terrain while charging; don't fight him near walls or jungle entrances when it's available.

playing.title: Hold W for the extended fight
playing.detail: W (Courage) deals damage around you for its duration, so save it for when you're already committed to a sustained trade rather than popping it on a poke exchange.

playing.title: Threaten R the instant it hits level 6
playing.detail: R (Demacian Justice) is an execute at 400 range; punish any overextension to farm or trade since his only disengage tool is the E dash, which has a long cooldown of its own.

playing.title: Punish his empty cooldowns
playing.detail: His Q, E, and ultimate are all multi-second commitments (Q 9-7s, E 14-12s, R starts at 140s); once he spends one to engage or farm, all-in immediately while he has no answer.

playing.title: Don't force it into a full rotation
playing.detail: If he's holding Q, E, and W all up at once, disengage using your own Q's speed burst instead of trading — the slow-into-knockup chain can flip an otherwise even fight.

playing.title: Bait with Conqueror, not with your first auto
playing.detail: Let him commit Q or E first before engaging; Conqueror rewards you for the extended fight that follows, not for the opening poke.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, and the win-rate figures above are measured from real games on the current patch (16.19.1); the matchup reasoning — why the numbers shake out this way — is my own read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Use [W] to retreat if you were hit by Ornn’s (Q) or close in to fight him instead. Maintain your Conqueror stacks while closing in to deal damage.
